title: proceedBranchFn wraps checkout-B/write/add/commit in one swallow-all try/catch,…
description:
proceedBranchFn wraps checkout-B/write/add/commit in one swallow-all try/catch, yet the resolver always returns 'implementing' regardless of git success. A failed branch/commit would leave the loop in 'implementing' with no cam/* branch. This matches the documented best-effort/never-throw contract (pollAndResolveGate has no try/catch), so it is intentional and non-blocking, but a future hardening could surface a failed branch creation instead of silently flipping phase.

Source: cam/issue-312
Review round: 1

suggestion-fingerprint: 713163004dde

spec.scope: In proceedBranchFn, surface a failed branch creation (checkout-B/write/add/commit) to the operator instead of silently returning 'implementing' when git failed and no cam/* branch exists. Preserve the documented best-effort/never-throw contract (the resolver must not throw).
acceptanceCriteria: When proceedBranchFn's git sequence fails and no cam/* branch was created, the failure is surfaced (durable marker/notification/log) rather than silently flipping the phase to 'implementing'.
The never-throw contract is preserved: the resolver still does not throw and the success-path behavior of pollAndResolveGate is unchanged.
A test covers the git-failure branch and asserts the surfacing plus that the phase does not silently advance to 'implementing' with no branch.
gotchas: Current behavior is intentional per the best-effort/never-throw contract and is non-blocking; add observability without breaking the contract.
